import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

trans = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
print(trans.head())
print("\nUnique Category values:", trans['Category'].unique())
print("\nUnique Program values:", trans['Program'].unique())
print("\nNumber of rows:", len(trans))

# Also check if Category column has Admin
admin_mask = trans['Category'].astype(str).str.lower().str.strip() == 'admin'
print("\nAdmin category rows count:", admin_mask.sum())
if admin_mask.sum()>0:
    print(trans[admin_mask].head())
    total_admin_category = trans.loc[admin_mask, 'Amount (INR)'].sum()
    print("Total admin category sum:", total_admin_category)
else:
    print("No exact 'Admin' category")

# Maybe Program = 'Admin (organisation-wide)'
program_admin_mask = trans['Program'].astype(str).str.contains('Admin', case=False, na=False)
print("\nProgram contains Admin rows count:", program_admin_mask.sum())
if program_admin_mask.sum()>0:
    total_program_admin = trans.loc[program_admin_mask, 'Amount (INR)'].sum()
    print("Total program Admin sum:", total_program_admin)
